digest.component_or_area: backend neutrality sweep / Jira adapter layering (J7)
propositions: inbound_fields.py must remain at package root because Data Center backend delegates to the same mapper as Cloud, and moving it to adapters/jira/ would violate the J7 bidirectional adapter seal.
The backend neutrality sweep exemption for inbound_fields.py documents a permanent architectural cost (shared mapper enabling sealed adapters) rather than temporary relocation debt.
Moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira_family/ would violate the mirror rule: root-core consumers (inbound_differ.py, peer_state.py) cannot import from the family layer.
The module's by-path lazy-load of adapters/jira/adf.py cannot be satisfied if relocated to jira_family, as routing through a string path would evade rather than satisfy the AST gate.
The sweep exemption wording was rewritten to explain why the file is deliberately exempt: keeping the DC-Cloud seal intact while both adapters share one mapper without opening a sibling-adapter edge.
